title: H1367 (2021 Regular): Concealed Weapons or Firearms Licensing

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2021-02-26; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2021/1367/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2314026))
provenance.note: Introduced version (filed 2021-02-26); no passage vote on file. Struck: 7 years (5 added); $55 and $45 (replaced by $39 and $32).

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.06(1), F.S.): Such licenses shall be valid throughout the state for a period of 5 years from the date of issuance.
Section 1 (s. 790.06(2)(h)5., F.S.): Presents evidence of equivalent experience with a firearm through participation in organized shooting competition or military service in the Armed Forces of the United States;
Section 1 (s. 790.06(5)(b), F.S.): A nonrefundable license fee of up to $39 if he or she has not previously been issued a statewide license or of up to $32 for renewal of a statewide license.
Section 1 (s. 790.06(11)(b)1., F.S.): Upon each license renewal, a licensee must provide the department with proof of completion of a firearms training or safety course or class of at least 8 hours in length taught by a state, county, or municipal law enforcement agency or a nationally recognized organization that promotes gun safety.
